card.name: Units inside written-out quantities
card.fires_on: The part of a number-plus-unit quantity right after the first digits, such as the last digit of 100 or 250, a hyphenated -minute or -hour, or mL and mg. It appears in preparation and administration instructions.

modes.label: Digits of a dose
modes.description: A later digit of a multi-digit strength, such as the 0 in 100 mg or 250 mg.
modes.example: Benznidazole Tablets 10<<0>> mg tablets into a cup.

modes.label: Unit or hyphenated duration
modes.description: The unit or hyphenated time piece after a number, such as -minute, -hour, mL, or mg.
